notes: Pack sizes/prices are ESTIMATES (Chicago-suburb Sam’s Club Addison / Jewel-Osco Glen Ellyn, late 2026). The 67 prototype ingredients keep the prototype’s generic packs; name-brand packs = generic × the prototype’s nameBrandMultiplier, rounded to a shelf price. Produce has no name-brand premium (name pack = generic). data/prices.json overrides any pack it lists. "meat": true marks proteins (bulk freezer packs). "extra": true marks everyday staples offered in the extras picker (some are also dinner ingredients). A store is omitted from "packs" when it does not carry the item.
